newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN Q1 GDP ROSE 2.6 PCT - STATS COMMITTEE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN Q1 GDP ROSE 2.6 PCT - STATS COMMITTEE.

text.p: Latvia's gross domestic product (GDP) rose 2.6 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the first three months of 1996, the statistics committee said on Wednesday.

Total GDP for the first quarter came to 696 million lats, which was a fall of 65 million lats from the 762 million lats recorded in the fourth quarter of 1996, a statistics committee spokesman told Reuters.
